comments.body:
To be clear, is the following description what you are expecting, Harshakumar Ummerpillai?
If you have two resources:
/parent/child

..and you are making updates to both /parent and /parent/child between each of the following version snapshots,

..and you create a version of /parent(v0),
followed by a version of /parent/child(v1),
followed by a version of /parent(v2),
followed by /parent/child(v3),

that the version trees would look like:
/parent(v0)/child(state when v0 was created)
/parent(v2)/child(v1)

Is that what you are asking for?

In this example there is no named version V1 of /project; that subtree only has one named version: V4.

In V4, the content of /project/inner1/inner2/inner3 is whatever the canonical content was at the time V4 was minted- not necessarily any named version of the /project/inner1/inner2/inner3 subtree. I think it is a bug to present named versions in those subtrees at all: they should simply list /project/fcr:versions/V4/inner1/inner2/inner3

Hi Andrew,
In this scenario, start creating versions from the last leaf node and go backwards to the parent. We can do a google hangout and show you the steps if that helps.

Thanks
Harsha
Please see Benjamin Armintor's comment. This is not a bug in the versioning model, it is a bug in the API. You should not ever have received a triple with that URI in it.

Aaron Birkland, when you get a chance to look into this ticket, here are two integration tests that define the expected behavior:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1091
Any estimates on which release these might get fixed? I would like to try if I can fix it locally and contribute back if possible. Any hints on which module/class I should be looking at?

Harshakumar Ummerpillai, I expect the ultimate resolution to this issue will come with the API specification for versioning, and the implementation that aligns with that specification.
In the meantime, however, the primary classes currently in-play are:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-kernel-modeshape/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/kernel/modeshape/FedoraResourceImpl.java
and
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-kernel-modeshape/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/kernel/modeshape/services/VersionServiceImpl.java
I'm closing this issue as part of a jira repository scrubbing. It appears to be out of date, no longer applicable, or addressed by future versions of Fedora.

Create a container structure like this
/rest/project/inner1/inner2/inner3

  • Create a version V1 for /rest/project/inner1/inner2/inner3
  • Create a version V2 for /rest/project/inner1/inner2
  • Create a version V3 for /rest/project/inner1
  • Create a version V4 for /rest/project
  • Create a version V5 for /rest/project/inner1/inner2/inner3

Now traverse the fcr:versions path from /project/fcr:versions/V4
You will eventually get to /rest/project/inner1/inner2/fcr:versions/V2

And if you review the contents within this path it will show
